def remove_Occ(s, ch):
    first = s.find(ch)
    if first == -1:
        return s
    last = s.rfind(ch)
    if first == last:
        # Only one occurrence: remove that single character
        return s[:first] + s[first + 1:]
    return s[:first] + s[first + 1:last] + s[last + 1:]

assert remove_Occ("hello", "l") == "heo"
